name: 55-decoration-longhand
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 17px; } p { margin: 8px 0; line-height: 1.8; } .a { text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-style: dotted; text-decoration-color: #cc0000; } .b { text-decoration-line: overline line-through; text-decoration-style: double; }
html:
text-decoration-line 与 style 分开声明：下划线点线。

overline 与 line-through 同时启用，双线样式。
